svg.title: Reimbursements: paid back exactly once, visibly — SoftTrack web design mockup (#137)
svg.desc: Finance gathers approved, unpaid expenses into a reimbursement batch (draft → approved → paid, with a CSV export) or carries them on the next payroll run as separate lines. Each expense records how it went out, once. The submitter sees “awaiting reimbursement” turn into “reimbursed on <date>”.

svg.text: A reimbursement batch moves draft → approved → paid, set by a finance admin; its CSV sums per person per currency, shaped like the payroll export. Including approved
expenses in a payroll run adds a distinct reimbursement line per person. No payment execution and no partial reimbursements: a part-payment is a refusal and a corrected claim.
